name: A Gallon of Blood
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: You have the option of offering larger quantities of the blood taken from our enemies. I will be glad to accept gallon sized offerings, adventurer.
narrative.offerRewardText: The blood of our enemies has been shed. I shall mix this blood with the rest that has been gathered. Once the offering is complete, the Ice Lord shall show these Stormpike dogs the full wrath of the Frostwolf Clan!
narrative.requestItemsText: You have the option of offering larger quantities of the blood taken from our enemies. I will be glad to accept gallon sized offerings, adventurer.
